subject.title: Feature: Slack workspace file injection + global systemPrompt (parity with Telegram)

question: Should Slack expose a public account/global `systemPrompt` contract, and what precedence should it have across per-channel entries, `*` defaults, DMs, MPIM/group DMs, and native slash commands?
rationale: This is a new public config surface in a prompt/session path, and prior Slack prompt work rejected a local global/DM prompt patch as the wrong API shape rather than leaving a mechanical implementation task.

options.title: Keep Per-Channel Canonical
options.body: Continue treating `channels.slack.channels.*.systemPrompt` and the `*` wildcard as the supported prompt surface, with `$includeText` handling file-backed ergonomics if that separate PR lands.

options.title: Approve Account-Level Prompt
options.body: Define `channels.slack.systemPrompt` as an explicit account/global prompt with documented stacking order and coverage for rooms, DMs, MPIMs, and slash commands.

options.title: Defer Until IncludeText Lands
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87771 before deciding whether repeated per-channel file prompts still justify a Slack-specific global field.

recommendation.title: Keep Per-Channel Canonical
recommendation.body: Continue treating `channels.slack.channels.*.systemPrompt` and the `*` wildcard as the supported prompt surface, with `$includeText` handling file-backed ergonomics if that separate PR lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They made the clearest prior Slack prompt product-boundary call in the rejected global/DM prompt PR and authored the merged scoped prompt replacement.
